text: Hello everyone, welcome back, today we will move on to the writing session,A Reply in an Advice column, by the end of this session, you are expected to analyze the writing sample in terms of content, language and editing, write a reply letter in an advice column using appropriate language and format.These are the pages we need in this session.Please get your textbooks and worksheets ready.Let's start.Recently, our school newspaper sets up a column called My Advice.Readers can write about their personal problems to the column for others' advice.This week, the column received a letter from a boy.Here is the letter.Let's read the letter and think about these questions.What problem does the boy have?Have you ever experienced similar problems?Did you receive any helpful advice?Well, according to the letter, the boy comes across a problem.His ears look weird, which means strange.His classmates tease him about it.He is laughed at by others.He feels terrible whenever he looks in the mirror.What a poor boy!He is tired of others teasing.Have you experienced similar problems?I believe many of you have experienced such growing pains.Maybe it's your baby fat or your slightly big nose.Actually, I had a similar problem when I was young.I used to be laughed at because I got pimples on my face.Luckily, I got some helpful advice from my mom.She told me pimples and acne wouldn't last long.She assured me that I would grow up to be a fair lady.Her advice comforted and encouraged me.I was so lucky.But the boy is not.Let's help him.Let's write a reply to give some suggestions.If your reply letter is enlightening and logical, it will be published in the next week's issue.Imagine seeing your letter on the school newspaper.Nice, isn't it?What will you say to the boy in your reply?Discuss in groups and brainstorm the information you want to include.You have one minute.小 publishers 与小 publishers 互相分享与小 publishers 互相表达与小 publishers 互相分享我们可以说我们是初向的试图主义者我们可以告诉一个私人故事和分析問題從不同的角度來看,就像我媽媽做的那樣。我們也可以提供一些實際的建議和鼓勵。如果需要的話,我們可以介紹一些方法來得到專業的幫助,例如見到一位醫生或學校的教授。我們可以寫出這麼多東西。如何把這些東西放進一封回答文件?讓我們來看一看在52個頁面的例子。如常,我們會從三個角度來分析這個例子。內容、語言和編輯。這些是一些指導的問題。你可以在53個頁面找到這個桌子。我們從例子的內容開始。我們有三個問題。誰是寫作者?什麼是回答的目標?寫作者對隊伍有什麼建議?為何寫作者會提供一個個人的例子?請快速掃描這個例子,然後找到答案。Derek的回答這是Derek寫的文章。他寫的文章是提供一些建議。他提供了幾個建議。例如,在2個頁面,他寫著表現並非一切。在3個頁面,我們可以選擇如何思考自己。而且,你必須學習如何接受自己。此外,他分享了他的經歷。恨恨他的嘴巴。當我們聽到別人談論相似的經歷,我們會感覺到他或她完全明白我們所感受。因此,在類似的經歷中,Derek展示了他與隊伍的相似。好,讓我們進入語言部分。寫作者如何開始和結尾?寫作者為何會使用人稱代詞?一分鐘內,我們可以掃描詞句並回答問題。寫作者開始用說你別擔心。你不孤獨。來顯示小孩應該感覺正常和理解。他以說如果每天早上你做這樣You will hopefully be able to change the way you think about yourself.Such support and encouragement can inspire the boy to take action.When giving the advice, the writer uses a lot of we instead of you.When will we use we rather than you?Maybe when we address our classmates or teammates.Therefore, using we can reveal the writer is on boy's side, so that he can get closer to the boy and his advice may sound more acceptable.Here comes the last part, editing.What punctuation mark does the writer use for emphasis and strong emotion?How does the writer use quotation marks?Scan the passage and complete the table.To emphasize the strong emotion,the writer uses exclamation marks, as we may find here and here.As for the second question,in paragraph 3,the writer uses quotation marks to indicate what the boy should say to himself when standing in front of the mirror.Such is an encouraging idea that can protect him from negative thoughts and low self-esteem.By now, you've probably had a clear picture of what to write in your reply.Can you recall?First, we can start the reply by yes, expressing our understanding of the boy's situation, or we can express our intention of writing.In the body part, we can write about a personal story.It can be the convincing example for the boy to learn from.We can analyze the problem from different perspectives, offer practical suggestions and even ways to get professional help.At the end of the reply, an encouragement can probably urge the boy to make a change.In terms of language, you can use what we have learned in the sample.You can also refer to these expressions.Even better, here are some quotes.When you want to encourage the boy, you may say,Beauty is only skin deep.When analyzing your personal story, you can review the truth.Focusing on appearance will make you lose your direction in life.Besides, you can help the boy feel the problem differently by quoting,Appearance is apparent, but an interesting soul is eternal.And what is most impressive is a person's temperament and character.In order to encourage the boy to make a change,you may say,People are not lovely because they are beautiful,but rather they are beautiful because they are lovely.Sometimes when you are writing to give suggestions or persuade others,you can quote sayings and famous people to make your advice more convincing.You can find these tables in your worksheets.While you are writing the reply, you may refer to this checklist as a guide.You can find it in your worksheets.Fifteen seconds to go through the checklist.Okay, now it's time for you to have a try.Write your reply in worksheets.You have three minutes.How are you going on with your writing?Have you finished?Well, after writing, you can refer to the checklistto polish your content, language, and editing.After this session, you can go on to do peer evaluationand provide suggestions of improvement.After that, you may revise and polish your own writingbased on others' advice.Assignments for today.Finish writing in exercise one on page 42 in workbook.Do peer evaluation according to the checklist.That's all for today.Thank you for learning with me.In the next session, we will learn somethingabout traditional Chinese clothing.See you next time.
